Key takeaways from Lotes's 2Q26 earnings call were mixed: (1) 2Q26 earnings
miss on GM deterioration amid rising material costs; (2) prolonged margin
headwinds into 2H26 before a new product cycle kicks in; (3) management remains
upbeat on server demand but expects server motherboard shipments to dip in
3Q on component supply shortages; (4) positive progress on QD and SOCAMM,
which could support revenue in 2H26 and 2027; (5) a conservative view on NB/
desktop end demand into 2H26; and (6) plans to issue NT$3bn in CB and 1.3mn
share to support working capital needs. Lotes’s margin headwinds are persisting
longer than expected, and supply chain constraints will limit revenue upside in
2H26. We cut our 2026/27/28 earnings estimates by 18%/11%/8% and lower our
Jun-27 PT to NT$2,500, based on ~18x 12M fwd EPS, at the high-end of the
historical valuation range to reflect general server upcycle and AI server
optionality. The stock has corrected ~30% from the recent peak (vs. TAIEX up 2%
over the same period), which we believe has priced in most of the near-
term downside. We expect the stock to be range-bound near term on margin
pressure, but remain constructive on the longer-term story as a key beneficiary of
the general server CPU upcycle. Stay OW.

嘉澤 2Q26 稅後 EPS 為 17.68 元，低於研究部原估 21.28 元。
受到金、銅、塑膠等原物料價格大幅上漲影響，且嘉澤為維持市佔
自行吸收成本，加上記憶體缺料壓抑伺服器出貨、新平台放量遞延
至 2027 年，短期獲利持續受到壓抑。研究部因此下修嘉澤 2026、
2027 年稅後 EPS 至 80.59 元（+15.3% YoY，原估 92.36 元）及 
110.19 元（+36.7% YoY，原估 119.88 元）。儘管現價對應 2027 
年本益比約 18 倍，惟考量新平台放量及毛利率修復需待 1H27，
短期營運動能明顯轉弱，故將投資評等由買進調降至中立，目標價

Lotes’ 2Q26 GM (-4.1ppt QoQ) was dampened by rising raw material costs
and learning curve for new products. As server ODMs seemingly face
component shortage of memory, PCB, CPU, etc., the company expects the
meaningful ramp-up of new CPU sockets for new server platform would be
delayed, which would also negatively impact its GM profile in 2H26. Despite
late ramp-up of new server platform, we remain positive on overall regular
server industry growth in 2026/27 and believe more meaningful ramp of
new server platform would drive Lotes’ business in 2027. We cut our TP to
NT$2,500 (20x 2027E EPS) from NT$3,000 (23x 2027E EPS). We cut our
multiple to factor in concerns over AI bubble risks and sustainability of
CSPs’ capex. Maintain our Buy rating.

We lower 2026/27/28F earnings by 17.2%/8.7%/5.8% to reflect rising raw material costs,
deteriorating NB/DT demand, and server customers’ supply chain mismatches. Lotes’

(e.g., Venice and Oak Stream) and new products (e.g., QD, SOCAMM, PCIe Gen 6

TP to TWD2,720, based on 24x 2027F EPS of TWD113.3 (from TWD2,980, based on 24x

Lotes released its 2Q26 results after market hours on 12 August. Lotes' 2Q26
earnings came in at TWD2.0bn (EPS: TWD17.6), which was 30% lower than our and 17%
lower than the street's expectations. While revenue was slightly lower than expected, 2Q26
gross margin decreased by 4.0pp QoQ to 45.5%, driven mainly by rising raw material costs
(eg, copper, gold, plastics) and a delayed margin uplift from new-generation CPU platforms
due to component shortages in the supply chain. Operating margin declined 7.0pp QoQ to
22.0%, reflecting higher-than-expected opex from a one-time employee stock bonus
expense. Looking into 3Q26, we expect top-line momentum to remain robust, driven
mainly by strength in Lotes' QD business. However, while QD growth supports the top line,
it also weighs on margins given its lower profitability profile. Combined with elevated raw
material costs and an unfavourable product mix shift, we believe margin pressure will
persist into 3Q26. We think a meaningful improvement in profitability will require higher
penetration of next-generation CPU platforms, which should provide a more substantial
margin boost once ramped. That said, despite these near-term headwinds, we remain
positive on Lotes given its long-term positioning as a key CPU server play. Lotes is hosting
results call on 13 August and we will provide updates in due course. We have a Buy (1)
rating on Lotes with a 12M TP of TWD3,533, based on a target PER of 28x applied to our
1-year-forward EPS forecast.

HEADLINE:
Lotes June sales: NT$3,094mn, +2% MoM/+17% YoY, tracking at 94%/95% of
Q226 UBSe/Street +8%/+8% QoQ.
OUR TAKE:
Q226 sales reached NT$9.5bn, below UBSe/Street due to component supply
constraints. Q326 revenue set to grow QoQ, though the magnitude depends on
component availability. Underlying server CPU demand remains intact with visibility
extending to 2028.

伺服器新平台將帶動嘉澤今年價、量雙增，營運再創新高，估今明年EPS 分
別達97.6 元及128.9 元，維持買進評等，並上修目標價3,200 元。

1. 2Q GM to see pressure, but expect improvements in 2H: 2Q GM will still
see some pressure because the price of plastics started to rise only in March,
with a full quarter of reflection in 2Q, but GM will kick in from 2H, so expect
to see margin improvements in 2H. AMD's Venice Socket is expected to ramp
from 2H26, while Intel's OakStream is expected to ramp in CY27.
2. Desktop seeing some deterioration vs beginning of year: Expects desktop
to fall 10-15% y/y in CY26 (vs down 5-10% y/y at beginning of year).
3. Server demand remains robust: Expects CY26 volumes to grow 15-20% y/y,
and preliminary forecast also points to +15% y/y in CY27.
4. ARM-based CPU to use socket: Currently only Ampere and Microsoft use
CPU socket. Lotes continues to engage in discussions with other CSPs, but
there is no confirmation that CPU socket will be adopted.
5. SOCAMM production to kick off in 2H, starting from 3Q.
6. Two NPO opportunities currently, one through LINTES (with Lotes being its
outsourcing partner), and one through Lotes directly. But there is no further
details provided vs 1Q earnings call.

益比區間約介於20-25 倍，看好嘉澤AI 伺服器滲透帶動之中長期成長潛力，

標本益比24 倍，推得目標價3,000 元，給予買進評等。

我們預估2026、2027年 EPS 分別為92.41、116.36元，我們基於2027
預估 EPS x 25倍本益比，目標價為2,910元，給予增加持股之投資評

我們重申買進評等，並將目標股價由2,250元（19倍2027年度每股稅後盈餘）上

Key Takeaways:
1.Lotes' 1Q revenue was NT$9.3B (+1% q/q, +20% y/y). GM was 49.5% (-200bps q/
q, -190bps y/y), 240bps below MSe and 210bps below the Street.

below MSe and 6% below the Street, for OpM of 29% (-90bps q/q, -250bps y/y).
3.Non-op income of NT$295M was below MSe but above the Street.
4.All told, net profit came in at NT$2.4B (-5% q/q, +5% y/y), 10% below MSe but in
line with the Street, for EPS of NT$21.38.
Lotes' 1Q gross margin missed both MSe and the Street, which we believe could be
attributed primarily to higher raw material costs and likely poorer efficiency of its
Vietnam facility. Its operating expenses were also higher than expected, despite the
fact that royalty payments to a key supplier had been completed as of the end of
CY25. We look forward to learning more details on the below from management on
their 1Q earnings call tomorrow at 4PM HKT:
1. What drove the 1Q results miss?
2. Are there any updates to guidance by segment, particularly servers?
3. Are there any new AI/CPO project wins to share with investors?

Lotes released its 1Q26 results after market hours on 13 May. We attribute the
lower-than-expected gross margin to the rising raw material costs (ie, copper, gold, etc.),
while the bottom line was boosted by a better-than-expected non-op gain. Looking ahead,
we see Lotes as a key beneficiary of the ongoing capex mix shift from AI training to
inference, as regular servers become increasingly critical for agentic AI workloads. At the
same time, the migration to higher-spec regular servers should further drive ASP upgrades
for Lotes' connector products, while its low AI revenue contribution leaves significant room
for upside as the AI infrastructure buildout broadens beyond GPU servers. Separately, we
will host the 1Q26 results at 4pm on 14 May and will update our model after factoring the
latest information from Lotes’ management. We have a Buy (1) rating on Lotes with a 12M
TP of TWD3,533, based on a target PER of 28x applied to our 1-year-forward EPS
forecast. Key risk: lower-than-expected adoption of server CPU platforms.

近來AI代理（Agentic AI）迅速火紅，成為市場關注焦點，激勵相關個股強揚表態。如昨（20）日盤面上，緯穎（6669）大漲4.6%、嘉澤（3533）更是勁揚5.4%，不但漲幅均遠勝於大盤，更攀上波段反彈高峰。資策會MIC產業情報研究所指出，AI發展共有四段進化，其中代理式AI（又稱AI代理）為第三個階段；而全球AI代理市場規模將從2025年的79.2億美元，以45.8%的年均複合成長率（CAGR），飆升至2034年的2,360.3億美元。外資摩根士丹利證券（大摩）在最新釋出的產業報告中認為，AI代理預期將帶動諸多硬體產業受惠，包括ABF載板、印刷電路板（PCB）、CPU插槽、周邊連接器、線材、被動元件，以及組裝廠等。其中，在伺服器與組裝領域方面，大摩認為，更多的CPU意味著需要更多伺服器組裝，在大中華科技硬體領域中，包括緯穎等OEM／ODM廠，因在通用伺服器市場占比較高，因此將成為重要的受益者之一。而在CPU插槽與連接元件領域，大摩認為，隨著伺服器CPU總市場規模不斷擴大，CPU插槽市場也將同步成長。台廠家澤與鴻海旗下子公司鴻騰精密，兩者全球市占高達70%至80%，因此將成為最大的受惠者。權證發行商建議，看好緯穎、嘉澤等「AI代理概念股」後市股價表現的投資人，可挑選相關連結的認購權證進行布局。挑選標準，則以價內外10%以內、剩餘天數超過100天等條件為主。

嘉澤財報／2025年 EPS 為70.17元 今年恢復成長

嘉澤（3533）11日公布2025年稅後純益78.65億元，年減15.2%，2025年每股稅後純益（EPS）為70.17元，2024年EPS為82.77元，該公司董事會決議擬配發35元現金股利，並將在明天舉行法說會，說明2026年展望。嘉澤2025年第4季稅後純益25.22億元，季增8.8%，年減13.2%，2025年第4季EPS為22.53元，2025年第3季EPS為20.71元，2024年第4季EPS為25.95元。嘉澤2025年第3季產品營收比重，伺服器40.3%（包括CPU插槽、DDR與PCIE）、筆電11.03%（包括SODDR、M.2、I/O、PD Cable）、桌機24.64%（包括所有連接器）、策略客戶9.83%、汽車8.09%、工業醫療2.44%、嘉基3.63%（包括高階擴充基座連接線、AOC與AEC）。展望2026年，法人表示，預期嘉澤將增長10%，而且今年下半年業績貢獻度才會比較明顯，今年毛利率目標51%，略低於去年，主要是快接頭（QD）與連接線等產品毛利較低，使得毛利率小幅下滑。推動嘉澤2026年業績增長，主要還是來自AI伺服器對高速傳輸的需求，筆電與桌機等產品都已經成熟，例如去年是PCIe 5，今年進入到PCIe 6，DDR也都提升到DDR5，今年下半年進入DDR6。另外，策略客戶今年業績可望有中到高個位數增長。針對高速連接器與連接線的展望？嘉澤之前說，包括SOCAMM、QD與其他，預期要到今年第2季量產，去年QD相關產品（包括UQD與NVQD）小量出貨1萬顆，今年第2季才會開始有業績貢獻。至於輝達相關產品占比，去年約2%，今年預估為5%到8%，包括GPU卡，以及PCIe 16x Slot等，主要是應用在企業端的AI伺服器。嘉澤去年資本支出約30億元，今年資本支出在25到30億元，主要是越南廠持續擴產，今年規劃越南廠宿舍與設備的支出，越南目前產能占比約7%，預期今年可以到15%。
